title: Carefully Created
description: Collection of Create mod addons carefully created
body:
My own selection of Create addons for 1.21.1, still WIP but it works.

I've played a bunch of hours and I think it's fun and balanced. I've removed some crafting recipies from other mods to focus more on the Create stuff.
Feel free to add me on Discord (NexusAho#6969) to give feedback or suggestions. And thank you for playing it.
